about: A real mission on the hosted app (Gemini 3.1 Pro, PayPal sandbox payouts, Render), replayed on the landing page. Recorded with guardrails on; the logo was approved when the agent asked.

business.name: Mama's Bakery
business.description: Fresh bread and pastries, baked every morning.

log.text: I will launch a complete website for Mama's Bakery by registering a domain, setting up hosting and SSL, creating an email address, and designing a logo.
Asked 2 vendors about a domain: Dotlark, mamasbakery.shop for 1 year (mamasbakery.com is taken) for $6.00; Harborname, mamasbakery.co for 1 year (mamasbakery.com is taken) for $11.00.
Going with Dotlark: mamasbakery.shop for 1 year (mamasbakery.com is taken) for $6.00.
Paid Dotlark $6.00 through PayPal. They checked the payment and delivered mamasbakery.shop (domain, 1 year).
Asked 2 vendors about hosting: Render, a static site for mamasbakery.shop (global CDN, HTTPS included) for free; Pinehost, hosting for mamasbakery.shop, 1 month for $12.00.
Going with Render: a static site for mamasbakery.shop (global CDN, HTTPS included) for free.
Nothing to pay: Render's price is $0.00, so no PayPal payout. Render delivered on the quote alone.
Render: "Render issues and renews TLS certificates for custom domains automatically, at no cost, so mamasbakery.shop gets HTTPS without a separate certificate."
I'd planned to buy an SSL certificate, but Render already includes it, so I've taken it out of the plan. That saves at least $3.00.
Asked 2 vendors about email: Postwell, email for mamasbakery.shop, 1 month for $3.50; Mailcrest, email for mamasbakery.shop, 1 month for $5.00.
Going with Postwell: email for mamasbakery.shop, 1 month for $3.50.
Postwell's quote tried to give me instructions, so I won't buy from them. Trying Mailcrest ($5.00) instead.
Paid Mailcrest $5.00 through PayPal. They checked the payment and delivered email for mamasbakery.shop (1 month).
Going with Pixelfern: a logo for Mama's Bakery for $12.00.
You approved Pixelfern's $12.00: Logo for Mama's Bakery.
Paid Pixelfern $12.00 through PayPal. They checked the payment and delivered logo for Mama's Bakery.
Everything is paid for. Writing the website…
Deploying Mama's Bakery to Render.
Render has it live at mamasbakery-shop-80c725.onrender.com (20s).
Mama's Bakery is live.
